title: Gas chromatography-mass spectrometry metabolic profiling, molecular simulation and dynamics of diverse phytochemicals of Punica granatum L. leaves against estrogen receptor.
authors: Usha, Talambedu; Middha, Sushil Kumar; Shanmugarajan, Dhivya; Babu, Dinesh; Goyal, Arvind Kumar; Yusufoglu, Hasan Soliman; Sidhalinghamurthy, Kora Rudraiah
one_liner_zh: 该文研究石榴叶植物成分对雌激素受体的抑制，属于小分子-蛋白互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且方法为分子对接与MD但对象无关，故判低分。
abstract: Introduction: Breast cancer is the most common type of cancer globally and its treatment with many FDA-approved synthetic drugs manifests various side effects. Alternatively, phytochemicals are natural reserves of novel drugs for cancer therapy. Punica granatum commonly known as pomegranate is a rich source of phytopharmaceuticals. Methods: The phytoconstituents of Punica granatum leaves were profiled using GC-MS/MS in the present work. Cytoscape-assisted network pharmacology of principal and prognostic biomarkers, which are immunohistochemically tested in breast cancer tissue, was carried out for the identification of protein target. Followed by, rigorous virtual screening of 145 phytoconstituents against the three ER isoforms (alpha, beta and gamma) was performed using Discovery Studio. The docked complexes were further evaluated for their flexibility and stability using GROMACS2016 through 50 ns long molecular dynamic simulations. Results: In the current study, we report the precise and systematic GC-MS/MS profiling of phytoconstituents (19 novel metabolites out of 145) of hydromethanolic extract of Punica granatum L. (pomegranate) leaves. These phytocompounds are various types of fatty acids, terpenes, heterocyclic compounds and flavonoids. 4-coumaric acid methyl ester was identified as the best inhibitor of ER isoforms with drug-likeness and no toxicity from ADMET screening. gamma-ligand binding domain complex showed the best interactions with minimum RMSD, constant Rg, and the maximum number of hydrogen bonds. Conclusion: We conclude that 4-coumaric acid methyl ester exhibits favourable drug-like properties comparable to tamoxifen, an FDA-approved breast cancer drug and can be tested further in preclinical studies.
abstract_zh: 引言：乳腺癌是全球最常见的癌症类型，其使用多种FDA批准的合成药物治疗会产生各种副作用。相比之下，植物化学物质是癌症治疗新药的自然储备。石榴（Punica granatum）俗称pomegranate，是植物药物的丰富来源。方法：本研究采用GC-MS/MS对石榴叶的植物成分进行了分析。通过Cytoscape辅助的网络药理学，对乳腺癌组织中免疫组化检测的主要和预后生物标志物进行了研究，以识别蛋白质靶点。随后，使用Discovery Studio对145种植物成分针对三种ER亚型（α、β和γ）进行了严格的虚拟筛选。对接复合物进一步通过GROMACS2016进行了50 ns的分子动力学模拟，以评估其灵活性和稳定性。结果：在本研究中，我们报告了石榴（Punica granatum L.）叶水甲醇提取物中植物成分（145种中19种新代谢物）的精确和系统GC-MS/MS分析。这些植物化合物包括多种脂肪酸、萜烯、杂环化合物和类黄酮。4-香豆酸甲酯被确定为ER亚型的最佳抑制剂，具有药物相似性且无毒性，通过ADMET筛选确认。γ-配体结合域复合物显示出最佳相互作用，具有最小RMSD、恒定Rg和最大氢键数量。结论：我们得出结论，4-香豆酸甲酯表现出与FDA批准的乳腺癌药物他莫昔芬相当的有利药物样特性，可进一步在临床前研究中测试。
